blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.
blocks.zh: 深层神经网络,包括大型语言模型,在各种任务上都取得了显著的性能. 然而,在培训或微调期间,她们容易过度自信。 在这部作品中,我们观察到不同模型的一致现象,即早期模型的校准较好,而后来的训练或微调则产生边际精度增益,但大大提高校准误差. 我们的分析表明,早期的模型在预测和特征方面都保留了不确定性意识,随着持续的培训,这种意识逐渐丧失. 为避免训练这种不确定意识,我们提议\textbf{EUA-Cal},一种将\textbf{E}作为\textbf{U}确定性\textbf{A}用于\textbf{Cal}跳动的新方法。 EUA-Cal引入了早期预测规范化,以保持早期预测不确定性和原型结构规范化,利用早期特征空间反映的不确定性,共同缓解过度自信. 关于图像分类和多选择问题回答的广泛实验涉及八个不同的模型,表明EUA-Cal优于最先进的校准方法.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In recent years, deep neural networks (DNNs), including large language models (LLMs), have achieved significant progress in image classification ( Zagoruyko and Komodakis, 2016 ) , object segmentation ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) , and natural language processing ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . Despite their remarkable performance, these models are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning, with the predicted confidence exceeding the actual accuracy ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ) . This overconfidence reflects an underestimate of the uncertainty in their predictions and can reduce their reliability, particularly in high-risk applications such as autonomous driving ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and medical diagnosis ( Huang et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 近年来,深层神经网络(DNNs),包括大型语言模型(LLMs),在图像分类(Zagoruyko和Komodakis,2016年),对象分化(Kirillov等,2023年),自然语言处理(Vaswani等,2017年)等方面取得了显著进展. 这些模型尽管性能出众,但在训练或微调期间仍容易产生过度自信,所预测的自信已超过实际准确度(郭等,2017;江等,2021. 这种过度自信反映出低估了他们的预测中的不确定性并会降低其可靠性,特别是在自主驾驶(张等,2025年)和医学诊断(黄等,2025年b)等高风险应用中.

blocks.en: To calibrate model confidence, various calibration techniques have been proposed, including post-hoc calibration ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Pan et al., 2020 ) , loss function and regularization designs ( Szegedy et al., 2016 ; Mukhoti et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Ni et al., 2025 ) , mixup-based methods ( Thulasidasan et al., 2019 ; Bouniot et al., 2025 ) , uncertainty-aware methods ( Sensoy et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , etc. Expected Calibration Error (ECE) ( Guo et al., 2017 ) is a commonly used metric for evaluating the calibration performance of these methods, which measures the discrepancy between predicted confidence and empirical accuracy across confidence bins. A lower value of ECE indicates better calibration performance, i.e., the model is aware of how uncertain its predictions are.

blocks.en: Some studies ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Mukhoti et al., 2020 ) have shown that DNNs tend to produce overconfident predictions with continued training. We observe a similar pattern across various models, where the early model is better calibrated but its calibration worsens as training continues. Figure 1 (a) illustrates the classification errors of three different models on the train and validation sets, along with the ECE on the validation set. On all three models, we observe that ECE reaches its minimum at an early stage of training or fine-tuning, but then increases in later stages, while accuracy improves only marginally. This indicates that there exists an early model that achieves the lowest ECE and exhibits the greatest uncertainty awareness in its predictions. However, this awareness is gradually lost during subsequent training, resulting in worse calibration performance.
blocks.zh: 一些研究(Guo等,2017;Mukhoti等,2020)显示,DNNs倾向于通过继续训练产生过度自信的预测. 我们从各种模式中观察到类似的模式,即早期模式的校正较好,但其校正随着培训的继续而恶化。 图1(a)显示列车和验证装置上三个不同型号的分类误差,以及验证装置上的欧洲经委会误差。 在所有三种模式中,我们观察到欧洲经委会在培训或微调的早期阶段达到最低水平,但随后在以后阶段有所增加,而准确性仅略有提高。 这表明存在一种早期模式,即实现欧洲经委会最低,在预测中表现出最大的不确定性。 然而,在随后的培训中,这种意识逐渐丧失,导致校正表现更差.

blocks.en: Beyond predictions of the early model, we observe that it also exhibits uncertainty awareness in feature structure. Figure 1 (b) visualizes the feature structure and the corresponding calibration performance of ResNet-50 at different training epochs. We find that features with low confidence (shown in lighter shades) are crucial for calibration. At epoch 40, many features have low confidence, but their cluster structure remains poorly defined. The model exhibits the lowest accuracy and the highest ECE. At epoch 60, corresponding to the early model in Figure 1 (a), clearer clusters emerge while features with low confidence remain near their boundaries. At this stage, accuracy improves and ECE reaches its minimum. By epoch 200, the model achieves the highest accuracy with the most compact clusters. However, features with low confidence almost disappear, while the ECE increases. These observations suggest that the early model with the best ECE forms a clear feature structure while retaining some low confidence features, demonstrating the best uncertainty awareness in its features. However, this uncertainty awareness also fades as training continues.
blocks.zh: 除了对早期模型的预测外,我们还注意到它也显示了特征结构中的不确定性意识。 图1 (b)可视化ResNet-50在不同训练时代的特征结构和相应的校正性能. 我们认为,低信心的特征(以更轻的阴影所显示)对于校正至关重要。 在"纪元40"时,许多地物的置信度都很低,但是它们的集群结构仍然定义不佳. 该模型的准确度最低,欧洲经委会最高。 在与图1(a)中的早期模型相对应的60世纪,出现了更清晰的集群,而信心低的地貌仍然靠近其边界。 在这一阶段,准确性有所提高,欧洲经委会达到了最低水平。 至"纪元200",该模型以最紧凑的集群实现最高精度. 然而,信心低的特点几乎消失,而欧洲经委会却在增加。 这些意见表明,欧洲经委会最优秀的早期模式形成一个明确的特征结构,同时保留一些低信心特征,表明其特征具有最好的不确定性意识。 然而,随着培训的继续,这种对不确定性的认识也逐渐消失。

blocks.en: To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness in predictions and features, we propose EUA-Cal , a novel method that exploits the E arly model as an U ncertainty A nchor for Cal ibration. Specifically, in the pre-learning stage, we obtain the early model by stopping training at a specific epoch, which is selected on validation sets. We then introduce Early Prediction Regularization (EPR) to preserve early predictive uncertainty and Prototype Structure Regularization (PSR) to exploit uncertainty awareness in features of the early model. Finally, we combine EPR and PSR to formulate the overall EUA-Cal objective, aiming to preserve uncertainty and mitigate overconfidence.
blocks.zh: 为了避免在预测和特征方面训练这种不确定性意识,我们提出EUA-Cal,这是一种新颖的方法,它利用了E arly模型,作为Cal Brible的U 确定性A指针. 具体地说,在学前阶段,我们通过在一个特定的时代停止训练来获得早期的模型,这个时代是在验证集上选定的. 然后我们引入了早期预测常态化(EPR),以保持早期预测不确定性和原型结构常态化(PSR),以利用早期模型特征中的不确定性意识. 最后,我们结合EPR和PSR来制定欧盟-加盟的总体目标,目的是保持不确定性并减轻过度自信.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We identify a general phenomenon in training or fine-tuning where the early model is better calibrated. Our analysis further shows that the early model preserves uncertainty awareness in both the predictions and the feature structure. However, this uncertainty is gradually lost as training continues, resulting in overconfidence. • We propose EUA-Cal, a novel method that exploits the uncertainty awareness retained by the early model as an anchor. Our method is achieved through regularization terms that EPR aligns current predictions with early predictions and PSR derives probability distributions from early feature structures, jointly mitigating overconfidence. • Our method achieves superior performance in calibration across diverse network architectures, including deep neural networks such as ResNet and DenseNet, as well as Transformer-based models such as ViT, Llama, and Qwen. Extensive experiments on eight models and six datasets demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Calibration for DNNs. Calibration aims to ensure that predicted confidence is indicative of the actual likelihood of correctness ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Post-hoc methods learn a calibration function on a validation set ( Kull et al., 2017 ; Guo et al., 2017 ; Pan et al., 2020 ) . Among them, Temperature Scaling ( Guo et al., 2017 ) is a widely used method that learns a single temperature to adjust the output logits. Despite their simplicity and effectiveness, post-hoc methods perform poorly under distribution shifts ( Ovadia et al., 2019 ) . Loss function and regularization designs reduce overconfidence by implicitly or explicitly maximizing the entropy of predictive distributions. Label Smoothing (LS) ( Szegedy et al., 2016 ) softens one-hot labels, while Focal Loss (FL) ( Mukhoti et al., 2020 ) implicitly increases the entropy of the predicted distribution. MbLS ( Liu et al., 2022 ) controls the margin on logit distances to prevent the model from non-informative predictions. BalCAL ( Ni et al., 2025 ) combines a fixed ETF classifier with a standard linear classifier to adjust confidence. Mixup-based methods were originally proposed to improve generalization and have been proven effective for calibration ( Thulasidasan et al., 2019 ; Noh et al., 2023 ; Bouniot et al., 2025 ) . Wang et al. (2023) note that the confidence penalty of Mixup would harm calibration and propose MIT to avoid the negative impact of the confidence penalty. Several methods propose calibration methods for specific network structures ( Jordahn and Olmos, 2024 ; Wang and Zhang, 2024 ; Ni et al., 2026 ) , but their generalizability across different structures remains unclear.
blocks.zh: 校正DNNs.校正旨在确保预测的置信度显示实际正确的可能性(张等,2023). 后荷克方法在验证集上学习校正功能(Kull等,2017;Guo等,2017;Pan等,2020.). 其中,"温度放大"(Guo等,2017年)是一种被广泛使用的方法,可以学习单温度来调整输出对数. 尽管方法简洁而有效,但在分配分流(Ovadia等, 2019年)下, 丢失功能和规范化设计通过隐含地或明确地将预测分布的 en最大化来降低过度自信. 标签平滑(LS)(Szegedy等,2016年)会软化一热标签,而焦距(FL)(Mukhoti等,2020年)则会隐含地增加预测分布的 en. MbLS (Liu等, 2022) 控制了对数距离的比值,以防止模型出现非信息预测. BalCAL(Ni等,2025年)将固定ETF分级器与标准线性分级器合并以调整置信度. 基于混合的方法最初是为了改进通俗化,并已证明对校准有效(Thulasidasan等,2019;Noh等,2023;Bouniot等,2025)。 王等(2023年)指出"混入"的置信处罚会损害校正,并提议"麻省理工"来避免置信处罚的负面影响. 几种方法提出了特定网络结构的校正方法(Jordahn and Olmos, 2024;Wang and Zhang,). 2024; Ni等, 2026),但是它们在不同结构上的通性仍然不清楚.

blocks.en: Calibration for Fine-tuned LLMs. Recent studies have focused on fine-tuned LLM calibration ( Jiang et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Traditional methods, such as MC-Dropout ( Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ) and Deep Ensemble ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017 ) provide uncertainty information but require multiple inferences when applied to fine-tuned LLMs. Several methods originally developed for the calibration of DNNs, such as Mixup and LS, have also been shown to effectively calibrate LLMs during fine-tuning ( Park and Caragea, 2022 ; Huang et al., 2025a ) . Compared with these methods, our method is also applicable to fine-tuned LLMs and achieves superior performance. Distillation ( Guo et al., 2021 ) improves calibration by knowledge distillation from calibrated model ensembles. However, this approach relies on an ensemble of multiple models and an additional validation set for calibration. IB-EDL ( Li et al., 2025 ) introduces an information bottleneck into the EDL ( Sensoy et al., 2018 ) framework to suppress spurious and excessive evidence, thus mitigating overconfidence in fine-tuned LLMs.
blocks.zh: 微调LLMs校正. 最近的研究侧重于微调LLM校正(Jiang等,2021;Yang等,2024). 传统方法,如MC-Dropout(Gal和Ghahramani,2016年)和Deep Ensemble(Lakshminarayanan等,2017年)提供了不确定性信息,但在被应用到微调LLMs时需要多重推论. 最初为DNN校正而开发的几种方法,如Mixup和LS,也被证明在微调时有效校正了LLMs(Park and Caragea, 2022;Huang等人, 2025a.). 与这些方法相比,我们的方法也适用于微调的LLMS并实现优等性能. 分馏(Guo等,2021年)通过从被校准的模型综艺中进行知识分馏来改进校正. 然而,这种方法依赖于多个模型的组合和额外的校正验证集. IB-EDL(Li等,2025年)向EDL(Sensoy等,2018年)框架引入了信息瓶颈来压制虚假和过度的证据,从而减轻了对微调LLMs的过度信心.

blocks.en: Early Prediction Regularization. As analyzed in Sec. 1 , prediction of the early model is better calibrated and retains reliable uncertainty awareness for samples. Motivated by this insight, we introduce Early Prediction Regularization (EPR) to preserve the specific uncertainty of samples captured at the early training stage. Formally, given the parameters 𝜽 t {\bm{\theta}}^{t} from the selected training iteration t t , we freeze the corresponding model f 𝜽 t f_{{\bm{\theta}}^{t}} . The EPR loss is defined as the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the early and current prediction distributions, i.e., ℒ EPR = 1 N ∑ i = 1 N D KL ( 𝒑 i t | | 𝒑 i ) = 1 N ∑ i = 1 N ∑ k = 1 K p i , k t log ( p i , k t p i , k ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{EPR}}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}D_{\mathrm{KL}}({\bm{p}}^{t}_{i}||{\bm{p}}_{i})=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\sum_{k=1}^{K}p^{t}_{i,k}\log\left(\frac{p^{t}_{i,k}}{p_{i,k}}\right), (1) where 𝒑 i t = { p i , k t } k = 1 K = softmax ​ ( f 𝜽 t ​ ( 𝒙 i ) ) {\bm{p}}^{t}_{i}=\{p_{i,k}^{t}\}_{k=1}^{K}=\text{softmax}(f_{{\bm{\theta}}^{t}}({\bm{x}}_{i})) is the early prediction distribution of sample 𝒙 i {\bm{x}}_{i} from the frozen early model. The traditional CE loss with hard label continuously pushes all samples toward one-hot prediction, regardless of the sample specific uncertainty. In contrast, early predictions retain sample uncertainty before the overconfidence emerges. EPR utilizes them as reliable references to constrain excessive confidence growth on uncertain samples, while preserving confident predictions for certain samples.

blocks.en: Datasets and Models. We evaluate our method on both image classification and multiple-choice question answering. For image classification, we conduct experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky and Hinton, 2009 ) , and Tiny-ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) datasets with different network architectures, including ResNet-50, ResNet-101 ( He et al., 2016 ) , Wide-ResNet-26-10 ( Zagoruyko and Komodakis, 2016 ) , DenseNet-121 ( Huang et al., 2017 ) , and ViT-B/32 ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) . For multiple-choice question answering, we consider SciQ ( Welbl et al., 2017 ) , ARC-Challenge (ARC-C) and ARC-Easy (ARC-E) ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , and CommonsenseQA (CSQA) ( Talmor et al., 2019 ) datasets. We fine-tune Llama3-8B, Llama3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , and Qwen3-8B-Base ( Yang et al., 2025 ) using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 数据集与模型. 我们在图像分类和多选择问题回答上评估我们的方法。 关于图像分类,我们进行了CIFAR-10,CIFAR-100(Krizzhevsky和Hinton,2009年)和Tiny-ImageNet(Deng等,2009年)不同网络架构的数据集的实验,包括ResNet-50,ResNet-101(He等,2016年),Wide-ResNet-26-10(Zagoruyko和Komodakis,2016年),DenseNet-121(Huang等,2017年)和Vit-B/32(Dosovitskiy等,2021年). 对于多选题的回答,我们考虑SciQ(Welbl等,2017年),ARC-Challenge(ARC-C)和ARC-Easy(ARC-E)(Clark等,2018年),以及CommonsenseQA(CSQA)(Talmor等,2019年)数据集. 我们微调了Llama3-8B,Llama3.1-8B (Grattafiori等,2024年),并使用LORA(Hu等,2022年)的Qwen3-8B-Base(Yang等,2025年).

blocks.en: Baselines and Metrics. For image classification, we compare EUA-Cal with various calibration methods: (i) the vanilla model trained with CE; (ii) implicit or explicit regularization, including LS ( Szegedy et al., 2016 ) , FL ( Mukhoti et al., 2020 ) , CRL ( Moon et al., 2020 ) , Distillation ( Guo et al., 2021 ) , MbLS ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , BalCAL ( Ni et al., 2025 ) , and CSAM ( Tan et al., 2026 ) ; (iii) data augmentation, including Mixup ( Thulasidasan et al., 2019 ) and MIT ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; (iv) architecture-specific methods, including PLP ( Wang and Zhang, 2024 ) and MaC-Cal ( Ni et al., 2026 ) . For multiple-choice question answering with fine-tuned LLMs, we evaluate all methods above except BalCAL, PLP, and MaC-Cal since they rely on specific components. We further include (v) uncertainty-aware methods, including EDL ( Sensoy et al., 2018 ) and IB-EDL ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Calibration is evaluated using ACC, ECE ( Guo et al., 2017 ) , and adaptive ECE (AECE) ( Nixon et al., 2019 ) . For out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, we adopt AUROC and FPR95 as metrics.

blocks.en: 4.2 Calibration Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 校准结果

blocks.en: We provide comprehensive comparisons of our method against state-of-the-art methods for model calibration on both image classification and multiple-choice question answering. Table 1 reports the calibration performance of our method with ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet. Compared with other calibration methods, our method significantly improves calibration performance across all datasets and achieves the best average rank among all methods. Several methods improve calibration at the cost of accuracy, such as the FL and PLP methods. In contrast, our EUA-Cal method obtains the lowest ECE and AECE on all three datasets while maintaining competitive accuracy. These results support the use of uncertainty information retained by the early model for calibration.
blocks.zh: 我们在图像分类和多选题回答上,全面比较了我们的方法与最先进的模型校正方法。 表1汇报了我们的方法与ResNet-50在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上的校正性能。 相较于其他校正方法,我们的方法大大地改善了所有数据集的校正性能,并在所有方法中达到最佳的平均分级. 几种方法以准确性为代价改进了校正,例如FL和PLP方法. 相比之下,我们的欧安会-加勒法在所有三个数据集上都获得最低的欧洲经委会和欧经委,同时保持竞争力的准确性。 这些结果支持使用早期校正模型所保留的不确定性信息.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the calibration results of Llama3-8B on SciQ, ARC-C, and ARC-E. Our method also achieves the best average rank and the lowest ECE and AECE on all three datasets. Compared with the second best method on each dataset, our method reduces ECE and AECE by 16.24% and 47.92% on average, respectively. Additional results on ResNet-101, Wide-ResNet-26-10, DenseNet-121, ViT-B/32, Llama3.1-8B, and Qwen3-8B-Base are provided in Appendix C.1 . The consistent improvements across these models further demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of EUA-Cal across diverse architectures.

blocks.en: 4.3 Calibration under Distribution Shift
blocks.zh: 4.3 分配调整

blocks.en: Maintaining reliable confidence estimates under distribution shift is particularly important in safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving, where systems must make safe decisions even in adverse weather. To evaluate the calibration robustness of our EUA-Cal method in this setting, we first train ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 and then evaluate on their corrupted versions, CIFAR-10-C and CIFAR-100-C ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ) , respectively. These corruptions include noise, blur, compression artifacts, and changes in brightness. Figure 4 illustrates the calibration performance of various methods with different shift levels. Across both datasets and all shift levels, our EUA-Cal method achieves lower ECE than most methods. This indicates that our EUA-Cal method maintains robust calibration performance under distribution shifts. In addition, we also present the OOD detection results in Table 4.3 . Across all settings, our EUA-Cal method consistently outperforms the vanilla model, improving AUROC by an average of 1.31% and reducing FPR95 by 1.79%. These results demonstrate that EUA-Cal maintains reliable uncertainty awareness under distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 维持可靠的信心估计值,在分配变化中,对于安全的关键应用尤为重要,如自主驾驶,即使在不利天气中,系统也必须作出安全的决定。 为了评价我们EUA-Cal方法在此环境下的校正稳健性,我们首先在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上进行ResNet-50的训练,然后评价其被腐蚀的版本,CIFAR-10-C和CIFAR-100-C(Hendrycks和Dietrich,2019年). 这些腐败包括噪音,模糊,压缩文物,以及亮度的变化等. 图4显示了不同班级不同方法的校正性能. 从数据集和所有变相水平来看,我们的欧统法实现的欧洲经委会比大多数方法要低。 这表明,在分配转移期间,我们的欧盟-加盟方法保持了稳健的校正性能。 此外,我们还在表4.3中介绍了检测结果。 在所有情况下,我们的欧盟-加盟方法一直比香草模式好,平均将AUROC改进了1.31%,并将FPR95减少1.79%。 这些结果表明,在分配转变的情况下,欧盟-加盟保持了可靠的不确定性意识。

blocks.en: Practical deployment of LLMs requires them to generalize beyond the domains covered by their fine-tuning data. To evaluate calibration under such distribution shifts, we fine-tune Llama3-8B on ARC-E and then evaluate on ARC-C, SciQ, and CSQA, as reported in Table 3 . Our method achieves the best average rank and the lowest AECE on all three datasets. It also achieves the lowest ECE on ARC-C and CSQA and ranks second on SciQ. Compared with the second best method on each dataset, our method reduces AECE by 30.94% on average. These results demonstrate that EUA-Cal maintains effective calibration performance when fine-tuning LLMs under distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 有限责任方案的实际部署要求它们将范围概括到微调数据所涵盖的领域之外。 为了评估在这种分配变化下的校正,我们微调了ARC-E上的Llama3-8B,然后如表3所报告,对ARC-C、SciQ和CSQA进行了评估。 我们的方法在所有三个数据集中都取得了最佳平均排名和最低AECE. 它还在ARC-C和CSQA上实现了最低的ECE,在SciQ上排名第二. 与每个数据集的第二好方法相比,我们的方法平均将ACECE减少30.94%. 这些结果表明,EUA-Cal在分销转移中微调LLMS时保持了有效的校正性能.

blocks.en: 4.4 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 进一步分析

blocks.en: Ablation Study. As shown in Table 5 , we evaluate several variants of our EUA-Cal method on ResNet-50 and Llama3-8B to investigate the effectiveness of EPR, PSR, and the selection of the anchor model. We find that the EPR variant reduces the ECE across all six datasets, while the PSR variant also improves calibration on most datasets. The complete EUA-Cal, which combines the two regularization terms, achieved the lowest ECE on each dataset, suggesting that predictions and feature structures of the early model provide complementary uncertainty awareness for calibration. For anchor model selection, we compare the early model with a late model that has higher validation accuracy but also higher validation ECE. Although the late model leads to slightly higher accuracy in most settings, its calibration is substantially worse. More analysis on the impact of model selection is provided in Appendix C.2 .
blocks.zh: 校勘研究. 如表5所示,我们评价了ResNet-50和Llama3-8B上的欧盟-加盟方法的若干变种,以调查EPR、PSR和选择锚定模型的有效性。 我们发现,EPR变体减少了所有六个数据集的欧洲经委会,而PSR变体也改善了大多数数据集的校正。 将两个正规化术语合并在一起的完整的欧安联-加勒系统在每个数据集上实现了最低的欧洲经委会,这表明早期模型的预测和特征结构为校正提供了互补的不确定性意识。 关于锚地模型的选择,我们比较早期模型和较晚的模型,后者具有更高的验证精度,但也具有更高的验证ECE. 虽然后期的模型在大多数设置中导致精度略高,但其校正却大为糟糕. 附录C.2进一步分析了模型选择的影响。

blocks.en: Impact of Hyperparameters. We explore the impact of hyperparameters α \alpha , β \beta and τ \tau on ResNet-50 and Llama3-8B. α \alpha and β \beta control the strengths of EPR loss and PSR loss, respectively. We recommend setting them within the range of [ 0.1 , 0.3 ] [0.1,0.3] . As shown in Figure 5 , our EUA-Cal method consistently improves the calibration performance within this range. Figure 9 shows the performance of EUA-Cal under different values of τ \tau , where τ ∗ \tau^{*} is obtained by minimizing NLL on the training set. Our EUA-Cal method maintains relatively stable accuracy and competitive calibration performance under different τ \tau settings. We recommend determining τ \tau through minimizing NLL on the training set, avoiding a separate hyperparameter search. For more detailed analyses, see Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 超参数的影响。 我们探索高参数α-α、β-β和\tau对ResNet-50和Llama3-8B的影响。 α-α和β-β-β分别控制EPR损失和PSR损失的优势. 我们建议将其设定在[0.1、0.3][0.1.0.3]的范围之内。 如图5所示,我们的欧盟-加盟方法在这一范围内不断提高校正性能。 图9显示了EUA-Cal在\tau的不同值下的性能,其中通过将培训集中的NLL最小化来得到\tau^{*}. 我们的EUA-Cal方法在不同\tau设置下保持相对稳定的准确性和竞争性校正性能. 我们建议通过尽量减少训练场的NLL来决定\tau,避免单独进行超参数搜索. 更详细的分析见附录C.3。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while continued training often yields modest accuracy gains while worsening calibration. Motivated by this observation, we proposed EUA-Cal, a novel method that exploits the early model as an uncertainty anchor for calibration. Our method is achieved through the regularization terms EPR and PSR to leverage the uncertainty awareness of the early model for calibration. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering on eight models indicate that our EUA-Cal method consistently improves calibration performance while maintaining competitive accuracy across different models and tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们观察到不同模型之间一直存在一种现象,即早期模型的校正较好,而继续培训往往能产生微小的准确性提高而使校正恶化. 基于这一观察,我们提出了EUA-Cal,这是一种新颖的方法,它利用早期的模型作为校正的不确定性锚. 我们的方法通过规范化术语EPR和PSR来实现,以利用早期模型对校正的不确定性认识. 在8个模型上大量进行图像分类和多选择问题回答的实验表明,我们的EUA-Cal方法不断提高校正性能,同时保持不同模型和任务的竞争性准确性.

blocks.en: A.2 Training Details
blocks.zh: A.2 培训细节

blocks.en: For image classification, we conduct experiments on five models including ResNet-50, ResNet-101, Wide-ResNet-26-10, DenseNet-121, and ViT-B/32. To learn these models, we use SGD as the optimizer with a momentum of 0.9 and a weight decay of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} and an initial learning rate of 0.1 unless otherwise specified. On CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, models are trained for 200 epochs with a batch size of 128. The learning rate is divided by 5 at epochs 60, 120, and 160. On Tiny-ImageNet, models are trained for 100 epochs with a batch size of 64. The learning rate is divided by 10 at epochs 40 and 60. We initialize ViT-B/32 from ImageNet-1K pretrained weights and fine-tune all its parameters using 224 × 224 224\times 224 inputs. For ViT-B/32 on CIFAR, we use a batch size of 64, an initial learning rate of 0.01 with cosine decay, no weight decay, and a gradient clipping norm of 1.

blocks.en: Figure 7 illustrates how the selection of anchor affects EUA-Cal. On CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, the model at epoch 60 yields the lowest ECE. Selecting the model at epoch 40 results in lower accuracy, whereas later models substantially increase the ECE with marginal accuracy gain. For ARC-C and ARC-E, using the pretrained Llama3-8B as the anchor model yields the lowest ECE. Later models increase the ECE, while the accuracy changes only slightly. These results indicate that the selection of the anchor model should consider the balance between classification performance and calibration performance, rather than simply selecting the earliest model.
blocks.zh: 图7说明了选择主播对欧盟-加勒的影响。 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上,60世纪的模型是欧洲经委会最低的。 在40世纪时选择该模型会导致精度较低,而后期模型则大大增加欧洲经委会的精度收益。 对ARC-C和ARC-E来说,使用经过预先训练的Llama3-8B作为锚定型号的欧洲经委会产量最低。 后来的模型增加了欧洲经委会,而准确性仅略有变化。 这些结果表明,选择锚地模型应当考虑分类性能和校准性能之间的平衡,而不是简单地选择最早的模型.
